record.what_it_does: Vercel is a cloud platform for building and hosting web apps, and its REST API lets developers programmatically manage projects, deployments, domains/DNS, environment variables, teams, and related resources.
record.auth_notes: Personal/team/project-scoped Bearer access tokens (prefix vcp_) are the primary single-account auth method, created instantly from the Account Tokens page. For multi-user, third-party integrations, Vercel documents a standard OAuth2 authorization-code flow (redirect URL with a short-lived `code`, exchanged via POST /v2/oauth/access_token for a long-lived Bearer access_token) managed through the Integrations Console. Building/using an OAuth integration is self-serve; only listing it publicly on the Marketplace requires a separate review.
record.access_notes: Any Vercel account (including the free Hobby plan) can create a scoped access token immediately from https://vercel.com/account/tokens with no payment required. OAuth2 integration client_id/client_secret are likewise created self-serve via the Integrations Console; only public Marketplace listing goes through an approval checklist.
